poland.title: Flag of Poland

colors.note: Represents courage and blood shed for independence

desc: - Two equal horizontal stripes of white above red, adopted on 1 August 1919 following independence
- One of the simplest flag designs among sovereign nations
trivia:
- The white represents peace; the red represents independence and blood of struggle
- Poland's flag is nearly identical to Indonesia's, differing only in the exact shade and proportions
- The Polish flag dates back to heraldic traditions from medieval Poland
